user.title: Swiss Meteo
user.description: Where should the forecast be for? Your Home Assistant location is pre-filled; move the marker for another place. The hourly forecast reads about 2 MB per model run (every hour); the daily forecast alone stays below 1 MB. Extended values add the temperature and precipitation uncertainty range, the cloud layers and the zero-degree level to the hourly forecast.

data.extended: Extended hourly values (uncertainty range, cloud layers, zero-degree level)
data.search: Place or postal code (optional; searching replaces the map location)
data.radar: Radar nowcast (rain now, nearest rain, rain in N minutes; about 8 MB a day)
data.open_meteo: Air quality, UV index and pollen forecast from Open-Meteo (not official MeteoSwiss data)

data_description.open_meteo: Optional. Adds modelled values from the free Open-Meteo API (Copernicus CAMS, a grid of about 11 km) as a separate device. They are neither measurements nor official MeteoSwiss data. While switched on, the coordinates of the forecast point (rounded to about a kilometre) are sent to open-meteo.com once an hour.

place.title: Forecast point and weather station
place.description: The forecast points and SwissMetNet stations nearest to the location, nearest first. Pick the point that matches your place (a postal code centre, a mountain spot or a station) and the station whose live values suit you best — altitude and exposure matter more than distance. Without a station, the current values come from the forecast. The pollen station (the three nearest of the 15 MeteoSwiss stations) adds the hourly concentrations of birch, grasses, alder, hazel, beech, ash and oak and the MeteoSwiss load class.

data_description.precip_station: Besides the weather stations, MeteoSwiss runs about 140 automatic rain gauges at other places. With a gauge chosen here, the measured precipitation comes from it; temperature, wind, pressure and all other values still come from the weather station. One is suggested when it is nearer than the weather station. "–" keeps the precipitation of the weather station.

search.title: Choose the place
search.description: The forecast points matching your search. The nearest stations are then offered around the chosen place.

reconfigure.title: Change the place
reconfigure.description: Move the marker or search for another place or postal code; the forecast point, the weather station and the pollen station are then picked around it in the next step. The entry keeps its entities, their ids and history; its title follows the new point. Hourly forecast, extended values, warnings and radar stay as set in Configure.

init.title: Swiss Meteo settings
init.description: Switch the hourly forecast, the extended values or the official warnings on or off, or pick another weather station (the eight nearest to the forecast point are listed), precipitation station or pollen station. Changing a setting reloads the entry; entity ids and history are kept.

rain_expected.name: Rain expected
rain_expected.description: Triggers when rain is forecast for one of the next six hours (at least 0.1 mm in an hour).

rain_cleared.name: Rain no longer expected
rain_cleared.description: Triggers when no rain is forecast for the next six hours any more.

frost_expected.name: Frost expected tonight
frost_expected.description: Triggers when the forecast drops to 0 °C or below before 09:00 the next morning.

new_forecast.name: New forecast run
new_forecast.description: Triggers when a new MeteoSwiss forecast run has been read (hourly).

warning_issued.name: Warning issued
warning_issued.description: Triggers when an official warning (MeteoSwiss via MeteoAlarm) comes into force for the forecast point.

warning_cleared.name: Warning cleared
warning_cleared.description: Triggers when no official warning is in force for the forecast point any more.

rain_starting.name: Rain approaching
rain_starting.description: Triggers when the radar shows rain reaching the forecast point within about 30 minutes, or rain has started there.

rain_started.name: Rain started
rain_started.description: Triggers when the radar shows rain at the forecast point.

rain_stopped.name: Rain stopped
rain_stopped.description: Triggers when the radar no longer shows rain at the forecast point.

strong_wind_expected.name: Strong wind expected
strong_wind_expected.description: Triggers when the forecast has gusts at or above the configured threshold within the next six hours.

strong_wind_cleared.name: Strong wind no longer expected
strong_wind_cleared.description: Triggers when no gusts above the threshold are forecast for the next six hours any more.

is_rain_expected.name: Rain is expected
is_rain_expected.description: Tests if rain is forecast for one of the next six hours.

is_dry.name: No rain is expected
is_dry.description: Tests if no rain is forecast for the next six hours.

is_frost_expected.name: Frost is expected tonight
is_frost_expected.description: Tests if the forecast drops to 0 °C or below before 09:00 the next morning.

is_warning_active.name: A warning is in force
is_warning_active.description: Passes while an official warning (MeteoSwiss via MeteoAlarm) is in force for the forecast point.

is_raining.name: It is raining
is_raining.description: Passes while the radar shows rain at the forecast point.

is_not_raining.name: It is not raining
is_not_raining.description: Passes while the radar shows no rain at the forecast point.

is_rain_approaching.name: Rain is approaching
is_rain_approaching.description: Passes while the radar shows rain reaching the forecast point within about 30 minutes, or rain there.

is_strong_wind_expected.name: Strong wind is expected
is_strong_wind_expected.description: Passes while gusts at or above the configured threshold are forecast for the next six hours.

import_history.name: Import station history
import_history.description: Reads the station's measurement archive from MeteoSwiss (hourly values since 1980, daily values since the station's start) and writes it into Home Assistant's long-term statistics: mean, minimum and maximum of the station sensors, plus precipitation, sunshine, evaporation and heating degree days as separate statistics (swiss_meteo:…). With a precipitation station, the precipitation comes from that station's archive. Run it once; running it again replaces the same period.

entry.name: Swiss Meteo entry
entry.description: The entry whose station is imported.

years.name: Years
years.description: How many years back, counted from the first of January of this year.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Hourly values (about 7 MB per decade file) or daily values (one file for the whole history, about 2.5 MB).

values.name: Values
values.description: Which groups to import; empty means all.

best_window.name: Best window
best_window.description: Finds the best window of the given length within the coming hours: the driest, the sunniest or the calmest. Returns start, end, precipitation, sunshine, strongest gust and mean temperature of that window (found: false when the forecast covers no full window).

entry.name: Swiss Meteo entry
entry.description: The entry whose forecast is used.

hours.name: Window length
hours.description: Length of the window in hours.

within.name: Look ahead
within.description: How many hours ahead the window may start.

criterion.name: What counts
criterion.description: Dry: least precipitation. Sunny: most sunshine. Calm: lowest gusts.

no_hourly.message: The entry has no hourly forecast yet; switch it on in the Configure dialog or wait for the next run.

history_import_failed.message: The station history could not be imported: {error}

forecast_unreachable.title: Swiss Meteo: forecast not readable
forecast_unreachable.description: The MeteoSwiss open data could not be read for several refreshes in a row ({error}). Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the MeteoSwiss service is down or has changed. The weather entity stays unavailable until then and recovers on its own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

station_unreadable.title: Swiss Meteo: weather station {station} not readable
station_unreadable.description: The live values of station {station} could not be read for an hour ({error}). If this persists for days, MeteoSwiss may have discontinued the station or changed its abbreviation: pick another station in the entry's Configure dialog. The station sensors stay unavailable until then; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

precip_station_unreadable.title: Swiss Meteo: precipitation station {station} not readable
precip_station_unreadable.description: The precipitation of station {station} could not be read for an hour ({error}). If this persists for days, MeteoSwiss may have discontinued the station or changed its abbreviation: pick another precipitation station, or none, in the entry's Configure dialog. The precipitation sensor stays unavailable until then; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

pollen_unreadable.title: Swiss Meteo: pollen station {station} not readable
pollen_unreadable.description: The pollen values of station {station} could not be read for several refreshes in a row ({error}). Outside the pollen season MeteoSwiss publishes no values for some stations; if it persists in season, pick another pollen station in the entry's Configure dialog. This notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

open_meteo_unreachable.title: Swiss Meteo: Open-Meteo not readable
open_meteo_unreachable.description: The Open-Meteo air quality API could not be read for several hours in a row ({error}). Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the Open-Meteo service is down or has changed. Air quality, UV index and pollen forecast become unavailable once the last forecast has run out and recover on their own; the MeteoSwiss data are not affected. This notice disappears with the next successful refresh.
